speakingGuide.explain: 描述改变过的一种学习方法。用“以前怎么学—为什么改—现在怎么学—有何变化”组织。
paragraphs: I used to learn English words by reading the same list many times. I did this at home before tests, and the words looked familiar. However, when I tried to speak, I often could not recall them without seeing the list.
以前考前反复看词表，虽然眼熟，开口却想不起。
清楚区分看着认识和主动回忆。

A few months ago, I changed my method. Now I cover the meanings and test myself. I also choose two words and make a short sentence about my own life. If I cannot remember a word, I check it and try again later.
几个月前改为遮住意思自测，用两个词写个人生活的句子，忘了再查。
用可执行的动作解释新方法。

This method takes more effort, but it shows me what I actually know. I still forget things, so I do not expect instant results. The main improvement is that I spend less time looking at words and more time trying to use them.
更费力但知道真正掌握多少，仍会忘，改善在于更多实际运用。
不夸大效果，讲具体变化。

practice.frame: I used to [old method], but now I [new method] because [reason].
practice.answer: I used to reread word lists, but now I test myself because I want to recall words without help.
practice.transfer: 换成你改过的一种方法；还没改过可以先用该方法练一天，再讲真实体验。

writingGuide.explain: 要求讨论自主学习与遵循教师指导两种观点。示范两边都解释，并以“基础阶段指导、逐渐增加自主”综合；不要只把独立理解成没人帮助。
outline: 主体一：自主学习可针对弱点
主体二：教师指导提供基础与反馈
结论：逐步移交学习责任
paragraphs: Some people believe students learn best when they work independently, while others emphasise following a teacher's instructions. Both views have value because effective learning requires personal effort as well as appropriate guidance. The balance between them may depend on the learner's experience, the difficulty of the task, and the support already available.
两者有价值，比例取决于经验、任务难度和支持。
题目要求讨论双方，因此引言不只宣称一种更好。

Independent work allows students to focus on their own needs. In a large class, some may understand a topic quickly while others require more practice. A learner working alone can spend additional time on a weak area instead of moving at the pace of the whole group. Choosing a task and checking the result can also develop responsibility. For example, a language learner who notices difficulty understanding numbers could select suitable recordings and review the mistakes afterwards. This kind of active decision-making helps students understand their learning rather than simply completing activities because someone else assigned them.
自主学习可按弱点和速度选择材料，如针对听数字困难做练习并复盘。
例子强调自主选择和复盘，而非单纯独处。

On the other hand, teachers provide structure and feedback that beginners may not be able to create themselves. A student can practise regularly but repeat the same error without recognising it. Clear instruction can explain the basic method, demonstrate a useful example, and prevent unnecessary confusion. Teachers can also choose a sequence of tasks that builds towards a more difficult skill. This is especially valuable when students lack the background knowledge needed to judge which materials are reliable or appropriate. Following good guidance at this stage does not prevent independence; it can provide the foundation for it.
初学者可能重复错误而不自知，教师能解释、示范、安排顺序，提供自主所需基础。
教师作用具体到反馈与任务顺序。

Overall, independent work offers flexibility and encourages responsibility, whereas teacher guidance supplies structure and correction. These approaches need not compete. A useful progression is to begin with clear explanations, allow increasing choice, and retain access to feedback as students become more capable of directing their own study.
先明确指导，再逐步增加选择并保留反馈。
给出两种方法如何结合。

practice.frame: Independent study allows students to [benefit], but teachers can help them [support].
practice.answer: Independent study allows students to focus on weaknesses, but teachers can help them recognise errors.
practice.transfer: 用你学习英语的一项困难，分别写自己能做什么、老师可以补充什么。

lessons.name: 学习方法比较
lessons.focus: 复习教育词汇；把同义替换整理成对照表。
lessons.text: Two study groups tried different ways of reviewing a short article. One group reread the text, while the other closed it and wrote down what they remembered. Both groups spent the same amount of time on the task. The tutor then discussed missing ideas with everyone. Students were allowed to choose either method for future homework. Because the groups had read different articles before the activity, the tutor did not present the exercise as a controlled experiment. No long-term follow-up was carried out after the lesson.
questions: Both groups spent equal time on the activity.
TRUE
与原文一致。证据：Both groups spent the same amount of time on the task.
Students had to keep using the method assigned to their group.
FALSE

One method led to better memory six months later.
NOT GIVEN

speakingGuide.explain: 描述希望看到的环保改善。先缩小到一个地点和一个可行措施，避免同时讨论所有环保问题。
paragraphs: An environmental improvement I would like to see is better recycling facilities in my neighbourhood. I noticed the problem last week when I tried to dispose of some cardboard boxes. The bins were difficult to identify, and the signs were faded.
上周丢纸箱时发现社区回收箱难辨、标识褪色。
从亲身遇到的小问题切入。

I would like the community centre to provide clearly labelled bins and a simple guide showing what belongs in each one. A short demonstration for residents could also help. The bins would need regular collection, otherwise people might stop using them.
希望提供清楚标签和分类指南，做简短示范，并及时清运。
措施要回应问题：标识不清就改善标识。

This change would make it easier for me and my neighbours to sort our waste properly. It would not solve every environmental problem, but it would remove a practical difficulty. I would be happy to help explain the system to other residents.
能方便居民分类，虽不能解决所有问题，却能消除实际障碍，自己愿意帮忙说明。
说明个人参与，让愿望更具体。

practice.answer: I'd like our community to label recycling bins clearly because the signs are hard to read. This would help people sort their waste.

writingGuide.explain: 题目只问如何鼓励家庭使用可再生能源，不必写成优缺点对半。措施要解决费用、可靠信息和住房条件等障碍。
outline: 引言：降低成本和实际障碍
主体一：可负担的财务支持
主体二：可靠信息与适用选项
结论：组合措施而非仅靠宣传
paragraphs: Encouraging households to use renewable energy requires more than general messages about the environment. Families need options that are affordable, understandable, and suitable for their homes. Financial support and reliable practical guidance are therefore likely to be important ways of helping people consider a change that might otherwise feel too expensive or complicated.
鼓励需要可负担、易理解且适合住房的选择，费用和实际指导都重要。
只围绕如何鼓励，避免离题大讲能源历史。

The first barrier is often the initial cost. Even if a household expects to save money over time, it may be unable to pay for equipment and installation at once. Carefully designed grants or affordable payment arrangements could make suitable projects easier to begin. Support should be explained clearly, including who qualifies and what costs remain. It should also consider families with lower incomes, rather than benefiting only people who already have enough money to invest. Before recommending a purchase, advisers should help households compare realistic costs and likely performance under their particular conditions.
初始费用可能阻碍家庭，补助或合理分期应清晰并考虑低收入者，按实际条件比较表现。
每条措施先指出障碍，再解释解决方式。

A second measure is to make trustworthy information easier to obtain. People may hesitate because they do not know which providers to trust or whether a system will work well in their property. Independent advice, clear installation standards, and transparent information about maintenance can reduce this uncertainty. Different housing situations also require different choices. Someone renting a flat may have little control over the roof, so encouragement cannot depend only on individual rooftop equipment. Where available, suitable renewable electricity options or community arrangements may give these households a way to participate without making changes they are not allowed to make.
独立建议、安装标准和维护信息降低疑虑；租房者不一定能装屋顶设备，可考虑当地可用的其他方案。
考虑不同家庭，不把一种技术当万能方案。

In conclusion, households are more likely to consider renewable energy when the financial and practical barriers are addressed together. Affordable support should be matched with reliable advice and options for different types of home. Public encouragement will be more convincing when people can see a clear, realistic route from interest to action.
支持与指导结合，兴趣才有可行的行动路径。
总结措施互补，不承诺固定收益。

practice.frame: Households may hesitate because [barrier]. This could be addressed through [measure].
practice.answer: Households may hesitate because installation is expensive. This could be addressed through clearly explained financial support.
practice.transfer: 选费用、信息或租房限制中的一项，写一个对症措施和它为何有用。

lessons.name: 能源选择
lessons.focus: 复习环境词汇；练习承认限制的让步句。
lessons.text: Residents of an apartment building discussed installing solar panels on their shared roof. An engineer first checked the roof's condition and estimated how much electricity the panels might generate. The estimate depended on weather and shading from nearby buildings. Residents voted to request quotations, but this did not authorise installation. Some wanted more information about maintenance costs. The building manager agreed to circulate the quotations before a second meeting. No final supplier has been selected, and the residents have not decided how costs would be divided among households.

Every household will pay an equal share.

The engineer's estimate depended partly on weather.
TRUE
与原文一致。证据：The estimate depended on weather and shading from nearby buildings.

speakingGuide.explain: 描述隐私重要的一个场景。用日常借手机、填表或发照片的经历说明，不必透露真实敏感信息。
paragraphs: A situation where privacy matters is lending someone my phone. Last month, a classmate asked to use mine to make a call because his battery was flat. I was happy to help, but I also had personal messages and photographs on the device.
同学手机没电借我手机打电话，我愿意帮忙，但手机有私信照片。
场景越具体，越容易说明 privacy。

I opened the calling screen before handing it over. My classmate made the call and returned the phone without looking at anything else. If I borrow a phone myself, I try to do exactly the same and ask before opening another app.
先打开拨号界面再给他，他打完归还没看其他内容；自己借手机也先征求同意。
用行为解释如何尊重隐私。

Privacy is important here because helping someone should not mean giving them access to every part of your life. I think simple habits like asking for permission can prevent awkward situations and help people trust one another.
帮助别人不等于开放所有信息，小习惯能避免尴尬并建立信任。
从小事提炼原则，不需要透露隐私本身。

practice.frame: Privacy matters when [situation]. I protect it by [action].
practice.answer: Privacy matters when I lend someone my phone. I protect it by opening only the app they need.
practice.transfer: 换成发合照或填在线表格的场景；只描述做法，不写真实账号、证件或私人信息。

writingGuide.explain: 需要判断公共交通数据收益是否大于隐私担忧。必须作比较，示范认为只有在收集最少数据、有保护措施时收益才更大。
outline: 引言：有条件认可收益更大
主体一：改善班次和资源配置
主体二：隐私风险与最小化收集
结论：收益依赖严格保护
paragraphs: Public transport systems can collect information about when and where passengers travel. This may help operators improve services, but detailed travel records can also reveal aspects of people's private lives. In my view, the benefits can outweigh the concerns only when data collection is limited to a clear purpose and strong protections are in place.
数据有助改善服务，但需用途明确、收集有限、保护到位，才认为收益超过风险。
明确 outweigh 的条件判断。

The main benefit is better understanding of passenger demand. If operators can see that a particular route is crowded at certain times, they may adjust capacity or scheduling. Information about lightly used services can also help them investigate whether routes or connections need improvement. This does not mean that every quiet service should be removed, since some provide essential access for a small group. Rather, data can provide a starting point for decisions alongside consultation with passengers. More informed planning may reduce unnecessary waiting and make better use of a limited transport budget.
客流帮助调整班次和容量，冷门线路也要结合乘客需求，不是直接取消。
把数据转化为服务决策的过程解释清楚。

The privacy concerns are nevertheless substantial. A detailed record linked to a named person could reveal regular destinations or routines. People may worry about unauthorised access or later use for purposes they did not expect. Operators should therefore ask whether they actually need individual identities to answer a planning question. Often, grouped information may be more appropriate. They should collect only what is necessary, explain the purpose clearly, restrict access, and avoid keeping detailed records indefinitely. Independent oversight can also help ensure that promised safeguards are followed rather than remaining statements that passengers cannot verify.
实名轨迹可能泄露日常活动，应看是否真需身份、优先汇总、限制访问和保存时间。
风险和防护一一对应，避免空泛说保护隐私。

In conclusion, transport data can support valuable service improvements, but these benefits do not automatically justify every form of collection. I would support a carefully limited system that protects passengers and is accountable for its use of information. Without those conditions, the privacy costs could be too great.
支持受约束且可监督的系统，非任何收集都合理。
不把有条件支持写成无条件赞成。

practice.frame: Travel data can help operators [benefit], but it should not reveal [private detail] unnecessarily.
practice.answer: Travel data can help operators plan bus frequency, but it should not reveal an individual's daily routine unnecessarily.
practice.transfer: 写一个不需要知道乘客姓名也能回答的交通规划问题，再说明一种保护方式。

It did not include passengers' names or destinations. The researcher explained that the map could identify crowded periods but could not show complete journeys. A city department asked whether the data could help plan staffing. Before making changes, it requested observations from staff at the busiest stations. The department has not released a comparison of staffing costs before and after the research.

speakingGuide.explain: 描述让社区变好的一个改变。先解释现状，再说希望如何改和谁受益。
paragraphs: A change that would improve my neighbourhood is a safer crossing near the park. I walk past that area several times a week. The park is popular, but the road outside it is busy, especially when children finish school.
公园外道路车多，放学时尤其忙，自己每周经过几次。
描述观察到的情况，避免空泛说社区不好。

At present, people sometimes wait a long time for a gap in the traffic. I would like the local council to consider a clearly marked crossing with suitable traffic signals. Better lighting would also make the area easier to use in the evening.
现在常等很久才能过马路，希望设清晰的过街标识和合适信号，改善照明。
提出的设施直接对应交通问题。

This would help families, older residents, and anyone who wants to walk to the park. I would feel more comfortable taking my grandparents there. It is a relatively small change, but it could make an everyday journey much less stressful.
家庭、老人和步行者受益，带祖父母去更安心，小改变能减少出行压力。
用自己的家人解释改变的意义。

practice.frame: Our neighbourhood needs [facility] because [problem]. It would help [people] to [benefit].
practice.answer: Our neighbourhood needs a safer crossing because the road is busy. It would help families to reach the park.
practice.transfer: 换成你真实经过的一段路或设施，具体说谁遇到什么困难。

writingGuide.explain: 比较步行便利与增加停车位的优先级。示范赞同步行优先，同时保留必要停车和无障碍需求。
outline: 主体一：公共空间惠及更多人
主体二：必要停车与替代出行
结论：更均衡的城市设计
paragraphs: Urban space is limited, so decisions about streets and parking affect how residents move around their city. I agree that making cities easier to walk around should generally take priority over adding more car parking. However, this should be combined with suitable transport alternatives and access for people who genuinely need to travel by vehicle.
一般支持步行优先，但需替代交通和必要车辆通行。
直答比较关系，不只赞美步行。

Improving walking routes can benefit a wide range of residents. Even people who use buses or cars often walk for part of their journey. Clear pavements, safe crossings, and connected routes make it easier to reach shops, schools, and public services. For example, a short journey to a local park may become practical for a family once a dangerous crossing is improved. By contrast, additional parking mainly helps those arriving by car and occupies land that could serve other purposes. A city should therefore consider how many different users can benefit from the same amount of public space.
开车或公交者也需走部分路，安全路口让更多人到达公共设施，而停车主要服务驾车者并占地。
用空间和受益者比较支持优先级。

Nevertheless, prioritising walking does not mean ignoring vehicle access. Some people have mobility limitations, and certain journeys involve equipment, deliveries, or distances that cannot reasonably be covered on foot. Cities should retain appropriate accessible parking and plan for essential services. Better public transport is also important, because residents living far from their destinations need a realistic alternative to driving. Changes should be based on local conditions and introduced with clear communication. Simply removing parking without considering these needs could create difficulties and reduce support for otherwise useful improvements.
行动受限者、配送和远距离出行需考虑，不能无替代就撤停车位。
承认特殊需要，让观点可执行。

In conclusion, safer and more connected walking routes should usually be a higher priority than expanding ordinary car parking. They can make daily destinations accessible to more people and use urban space effectively. The strongest approach combines this priority with essential vehicle access and reliable options for longer journeys.
步行优先与必要通行、长途交通配合。
重申一般优先而非全面禁车。

practice.frame: Improving [walking feature] helps [group] reach [destination], while more parking mainly benefits [group].
practice.answer: Improving crossings helps families reach local parks, while more parking mainly benefits people arriving by car.
practice.transfer: 选择你附近一处步行困难，写改善后谁受益，并补一句仍需保留的车辆需求。

Engineers observed traffic for two weeks before approving the change. Some shop owners worried that a nearby loading area would disappear, but the final design retained it. Residents were invited to comment after the crossing opened. The council recorded their comments without measuring changes in clinic attendance. It plans to review the crossing again after the winter months.
questions: The loading area was retained in the final design.
TRUE
与原文一致。证据：Some shop owners worried that a nearby loading area would disappear, but the final design retained it.
The crossing was moved further from the bus stop.

Clinic attendance increased after the crossing opened.

speakingGuide.explain: 描述需要持续练习的目标。说出起点、反复做的动作和可观察的进步，目标不必很大。
paragraphs: A goal that required regular practice was learning to type without looking at the keyboard. I started earlier this year because typing assignments was taking me too long. At first, I had to search for almost every letter.
今年想学盲打，因为写作业打字慢，起初几乎每个字母都要找。
用开始时的困难建立前后对比。

I practised for ten minutes after dinner on most days. I began with a few keys and gradually added more. Instead of trying to be fast immediately, I concentrated on accuracy. I also repeated short sentences that I had typed incorrectly.
多数日子饭后练十分钟，从少量键开始，重准确再提速，重练错句。
练习频率、方法和纠错动作都要具体。

After several weeks, I noticed that I could finish a paragraph with fewer pauses. I still make mistakes, but I no longer look down all the time. The experience taught me to break a difficult goal into small steps and repeat them patiently.
几周后停顿变少，仍会错但不总低头，学会拆分目标耐心重复。
进步可用行为描述，不必编造精确速度。

practice.frame: I wanted to improve [skill], so I practised [action] for [time] each day.
practice.answer: I wanted to improve my typing, so I practised short sentences for ten minutes each day.
practice.transfer: 换成运动、乐器或英语目标，讲一个你能观察到的前后变化。

writingGuide.explain: 讨论小习惯与偶尔高强度努力的两种价值。示范按任务类型区分：技能积累靠规律，完整项目还需集中时间。
outline: 引言：两者适用情境不同
主体一：日常重复形成积累
主体二：长时段适合完整任务
结论：规律为基础并安排集中练习
phrases: 在前期练习基础上推进
paragraphs: Some goals are pursued through small daily habits, while others involve occasional periods of intensive effort. Both approaches can be effective, but they suit different needs. Regular habits are particularly useful for building and maintaining skills, whereas longer sessions may be necessary when a task requires sustained concentration or a complete performance.
日常习惯适合积累维持技能，集中努力适合完整或深入任务。
为双方讨论设定任务差异。

Daily practice has the advantage of being manageable and repeatable. A learner may find ten minutes of vocabulary review easier to fit into a busy day than a large study session at the weekend. Repeated contact also creates opportunities to notice forgotten material and practise it again. Progress may feel slow at first, but the routine keeps the goal present instead of allowing long gaps between attempts. This approach works best when the activity is purposeful. Repeating an exercise without checking mistakes is less valuable than using a short session to address one clear weakness and review the result.
十分钟复习容易安排、可多次发现遗忘，但应有目标和纠错，不是机械重复。
解释短练习如何带来进步，并指出质量条件。

Intensive effort has different strengths. Some activities cannot be divided into very small pieces without losing their purpose. A student preparing for an examination, for instance, needs occasional practice completing a full paper under timed conditions. Similarly, writing a substantial report may require a longer period to connect ideas and revise the whole argument. The difficulty is that such sessions can be tiring and easy to postpone if they are the only form of preparation. They are likely to be more productive when the person has already developed basic knowledge and skills through regular work.
完整计时试卷或报告修改需较长时段，但仅靠突击易疲劳、拖延，基础来自日常工作。
给出不能切得太碎的反例。

Overall, small habits provide continuity, while intensive sessions allow deeper or more complete practice. I would use daily activity as a foundation and schedule longer periods for tasks that genuinely require them. The most effective choice depends on the goal, rather than on the assumption that one pattern of effort is always superior.
规律打底，必要时安排长练习，按目标选择。
综合双方，不空泛重复都有效。

practice.frame: Daily practice helps me [benefit], but a longer session is needed when [task].
practice.answer: Daily practice helps me review vocabulary, but a longer session is needed when I complete a full mock test.
practice.transfer: 把你的雅思准备拆成一个十分钟能做的动作和一个需要完整时段的任务。

lessons.focus: 复习习惯词汇；先解释原因，再给可执行建议。
lessons.text: A language club invited members to try a daily reading routine for one month. Participants chose their own books and were encouraged to begin with ten minutes. There was no requirement to finish a particular number of pages. Members kept private notes and could share ideas at weekly meetings. Several said that choosing easier texts helped them continue on busy days. The organiser collected comments rather than checking every reading record. The club did not test whether members' vocabulary had improved. Next month, it will offer a session on selecting suitable reading material.
questions: Members were required to finish a fixed number of pages.
FALSE
与原文矛盾。证据：There was no requirement to finish a particular number of pages.
Vocabulary test scores improved during the month.
NOT GIVEN

Participants could choose their own books.
TRUE
与原文一致。证据：Participants chose their own books and were encouraged to begin with ten minutes.

speakingGuide.explain: 描述一次期限紧的任务。按任务、困难、应对、结果说，重点突出你如何分配时间。
paragraphs: Last term, I had to finish a short report by Friday while preparing for another test. I realised on Wednesday evening that I had less time than I expected. I was worried because I had collected information but had not organised it.
上学期周五交报告，同时准备考试，周三才发现时间紧，资料有了却没组织。
困难要具体：不是只有 busy，而是两项任务冲突。

I wrote a list of the essential parts and divided the remaining time into small blocks. First, I completed a simple draft. Then I checked the examples and corrected unclear sentences. I stopped trying to make every sentence perfect before moving on.
列必要部分、分配时间，先写初稿，再核对例子改句，不每句反复追求完美。
按先后顺序说采取了哪些动作。

I submitted the report on time and still had a little time to review for the test. The experience taught me to set priorities and leave time for checking. Next time, I would make the outline earlier instead of waiting until the deadline was close.
按时交稿也能复习，下次更早列提纲并留检查时间。
结尾承认可以改进之处。

practice.answer: I had to finish a report by Friday. I managed it by writing an outline and dividing the work into short sessions.

writingGuide.explain: 灵活截止日期是否提高质量？示范部分同意，区分有理由的延期和无限拖延，并考虑协作依赖。
outline: 引言：灵活性有条件有效
主体一：应对意外并留修改时间
主体二：拖延及连锁影响
结论：明确规则下适度灵活
paragraphs: Deadlines help people organise their work, but an inflexible date can sometimes lead to rushed results. I partly agree that flexible deadlines improve quality. Extra time can be valuable when there is a genuine difficulty or a clear need for revision, although unlimited flexibility may create uncertainty and encourage people to delay important tasks.
合理延期可提高质量，但无上限灵活会带来不确定和拖延。
用 partly agree 明确程度。

A reasonable extension can allow someone to address a problem properly rather than submit work they know is incomplete. For example, a student preparing a report may discover that an important source is unavailable and need time to find an appropriate alternative. A short extension could support a better argument instead of forcing the student to use weak evidence simply to finish. Flexibility can also help when illness or an unexpected responsibility interrupts a sensible plan. In these situations, the original deadline may no longer reflect the time actually available, so adjusting it can make the assessment of quality fairer.
关键资料拿不到或生病时，适度延期可避免用差证据、让条件更公平。
举额外时间真正能改善内容的场景。

However, deadlines often connect several people's activities. If one team member submits work late, others may have less time to review it or complete the next stage. A policy that allows repeated extensions without explanation could also make planning difficult and reduce motivation to begin early. Flexibility should therefore come with clear expectations. People should communicate problems promptly, explain what additional time will achieve, and agree on a revised date. Smaller interim deadlines can help identify difficulties before the final stage, while preserving enough structure for everyone involved to organise their work.
协作中一人晚交会压缩他人时间，因此应及时说明、约定新日期、设置阶段节点。
解释外部影响，并给管理条件。

In conclusion, flexible deadlines can improve quality when they respond to genuine obstacles and support purposeful revision. They are less useful when they simply remove accountability. A combination of clear planning, early communication, and limited adjustments is more effective than either rigid dates in every situation or unrestricted extensions.
清楚规划加有限调整，比全刚性或任意延期更有效。
立场与引言一致。

practice.frame: An extension may improve [task] if [reason], but it should include [condition].
practice.answer: An extension may improve a report if a key source is unavailable, but it should include a clear revised deadline.
practice.transfer: 先写一个合理延期理由，再写延期怎样影响别人以及如何减少影响。

The final publication date stayed the same. Some writers welcomed the extra feedback, while others found that interviews were still unfinished at the new deadline. The manager allowed exceptions when a source was unavailable, provided the writer explained the delay. The team counted late submissions but did not survey readers about article quality. It will review the arrangement after the next two editions.

NOT GIVEN
原文没有提供这项结果或数量，不能凭常识推断。
The external publication date remained unchanged.
TRUE

No exceptions to the internal deadline were permitted.
FALSE
与原文矛盾。证据：The manager allowed exceptions when a source was unavailable, provided the writer explained the delay.

speakingGuide.explain: 描述想进一步了解的地方。可以是本地老街或博物馆，讲已知信息、好奇点和了解方式。
paragraphs: I would like to learn more about an old street in my city. I walked through it with a friend last month and noticed several buildings with unusual doors and narrow courtyards. I had passed nearby before, but I had never explored the street properly.
上个月与朋友走过本市老街，看到特别的门和院落，以前没认真逛过。
不需要远方名胜，熟悉地点更容易讲。

I am curious about who lived there and how the area has changed. I would like to visit the local museum and look for old photographs. If possible, I would also join a guided walk or speak to a resident who knows the area well.
想知道谁住过、地区如何变迁，计划查博物馆旧照片、参加讲解或询问居民。
提出两个具体问题替代泛泛说 interesting。

Learning about the street would help me understand my own city better. It looks attractive, but I think its stories would make it much more meaningful. I would enjoy sharing what I learned with friends when we visited again.
故事能让漂亮建筑更有意义，也更了解自己的城市。
解释知识会怎样改变参观体验。

outline: 引言：旅游既支持也可能扭曲文化
主体一：收入与传承机会
主体二：商业化和居民控制
结论：让当地人参与决定
paragraphs: Tourism can create interest in local culture and provide money to maintain it. However, the same commercial interest may change how traditions are practised and who controls them. Its advantages and disadvantages should therefore be considered together, rather than assuming that more visitors will automatically lead to better cultural preservation.
旅游带来关注和资金，也可能改变传统实践与控制权。
利弊都落在文化保护上。

One advantage is that tourism can give traditional activities a practical source of support. A craftsperson may earn income by selling handmade products or offering demonstrations, making it easier to continue using skills that might otherwise disappear. Entrance fees can also contribute to the maintenance of historic buildings, provided that the money is managed appropriately. Visitors' questions may encourage communities to record stories and explain the meaning of local practices. When residents choose how to present their culture, this attention can create opportunities for younger people to learn from experienced members of the community.
手艺销售和示范提供收入，门票可维护历史建筑，游客兴趣也推动故事记录和年轻人学习。
解释收入如何转化为延续技艺。

The disadvantage is that activities may be changed mainly to meet visitor expectations. A ceremony could be shortened, repeated, or moved to a convenient time until its original meaning becomes less important than its entertainment value. Income may also go mainly to outside businesses, leaving local people with little influence over decisions. If the most profitable activities receive all the attention, less visible parts of the culture may be neglected. These problems suggest that residents should participate in planning and decide which practices can be shared, how they are explained, and where tourism income is directed.
仪式为游客缩短或重复，意义可能被娱乐替代；外部企业获利、冷门文化被忽视。
用商业调整说明负面机制，不只说拥挤。

Overall, tourism can help preserve culture through funding, employment, and renewed interest, but it can also encourage simplification and loss of local control. The balance depends on how tourism is organised. Cultural preservation is more likely when the community remains an active decision-maker rather than becoming only a background for visitors' experiences.
当地人参与决定展示方式和资金用途，才更可能实现保护。
总结决定利弊的组织条件。

practice.frame: Tourism can preserve [cultural activity] by [benefit], but it may also [risk].
practice.answer: Tourism can preserve traditional crafts by providing income, but it may also encourage simpler products made only for visitors.
practice.transfer: 选一项地方文化，分别写一种旅游带来的支持和一种可能改变其意义的风险。

They plan to ask residents whether the walks affect everyday life before increasing the number of tours.

speakingGuide.explain: 描述获取新信息后改变判断的经历。旧结论和新结论要清楚不同，并说明是什么证据让你改变。
paragraphs: I used to think that audiobooks were not useful for language learning because listening felt too passive. I formed this opinion after trying a recording that was much too difficult for me. I could hardly follow it and quickly gave up.
曾认为有声书学习太被动，因为第一次材料太难、听不懂就放弃。
说清旧看法从哪里来。

Later, a friend showed me an easier story with a written version. I listened to a short section, read the text, and listened again. This time, I could connect the sounds with words I already knew. I also noticed how the speaker grouped phrases.
朋友提供带文本的简单故事，短段听读再听，能把声音和熟词对应，也注意到短语分组。
新证据必须能解释看法为什么改变。

I changed my mind about audiobooks. I still think reading and speaking practice are necessary, but suitable recordings can be helpful too. The experience taught me not to judge a whole method from one attempt with the wrong material.
现在认为合适录音有帮助，仍需读说练习，不应凭一次不合适尝试否定方法。
新结论可以有条件，不需从全盘否定变全盘肯定。

writingGuide.explain: 题目问额外学业支持是否应强制。示范反对一律强制，但支持容易获得并针对有需要者主动提供。不要反对帮助本身。
outline: 引言：支持帮助，反对一刀切强制
主体一：学生需求与时间不同
主体二：识别困难并降低求助门槛
phrases: 识别可能遇到困难的学生
paragraphs: Universities should make academic help available to students who need it, but this does not necessarily mean that every student should be required to attend additional support sessions. I disagree with making such support compulsory for everyone. A more targeted approach can respond to genuine difficulties while respecting different needs and demands on students' time.
应提供支持，但反对人人强制参加，建议按需要定向帮助。
区分支持本身和 compulsory，避免答偏。

Students do not all struggle with the same skills. One may need help organising an essay, while another is confident in writing but finds a particular mathematical method difficult. Requiring both to attend the same general session may use time without addressing either problem effectively. Some students also balance study with employment or family responsibilities. An extra compulsory commitment could make their schedule harder to manage, especially if the material repeats something they already understand. Universities should therefore consider whether attendance will provide a clear benefit rather than assuming that more scheduled hours always mean better learning.
学生弱点不同，统一课程可能不适用，工作和家庭责任也影响时间。
两种学生需求的例子说明一刀切问题。

However, leaving students entirely responsible for finding help can also be ineffective. Those who are struggling may feel embarrassed, fail to recognise a weakness, or not know which service to contact. Universities can respond through early feedback, brief skills assessments, and personal invitations to suitable support. Teachers could explain why a particular workshop would help and offer different times or formats where possible. In cases where a specific foundation is essential for further study, a clearly justified requirement may be reasonable. The important distinction is between a targeted response to an identified need and a blanket rule covering all students.
完全等学生求助也不够，应早反馈、评估和邀请；必要基础可有明确理由地要求补习。
承认反方合理动机并给替代方案。

In conclusion, additional support should be accessible and actively recommended, but it should not automatically be compulsory for everyone. Universities can use evidence about students' needs to direct help more effectively. This would preserve the value of support while avoiding unnecessary demands on people who require a different form of assistance.
积极推荐且容易获取，不一律强制。
结论与反对一律强制保持一致。

practice.frame: Compulsory support may not help students who [situation]. A better option is [targeted support].
practice.answer: Compulsory support may not help students who already understand the material. A better option is a workshop focused on an identified weakness.
practice.transfer: 选你需要的一项支持，解释为什么同一种课未必适合每个同学。

The results therefore did not prove that the tutorials alone caused the difference. Students were invited to describe which activities they found helpful. Several mentioned feedback on draft answers. The college plans to offer tutorials again, but it has not decided whether to change their length or frequency.

speakingGuide.explain: 描述希望更耐用的产品。可以是已经拥有的物品，说明哪里先坏、希望如何改善以及为何在意。
paragraphs: A product I would like to last longer is my pair of headphones. I use them when I listen to English recordings at home and on the bus. I bought them about a year ago, and the sound is still clear.
耳机用约一年，在家和公交上听英语，声音本来清楚。
明确一个产品，而不是泛谈所有电子设备。

writingGuide.explain: 是否应要求制造商让产品更易维修？主体必须讨论制造商设计和提供零件的责任，而不是重复个人应修理物品。
outline: 引言：支持合理维修要求
主体一：延长使用并让消费者可选择
主体二：安全与成本下的合理规则
结论：明确可执行的责任
paragraphs: Many products are discarded because one component fails, even though the rest remains useful. I agree that manufacturers should be required to make products easier to repair. Reasonable rules on design, spare parts, and information could give consumers a genuine choice, while still allowing appropriate limits where repair involves serious safety concerns.
支持要求制造商改善设计、备件和信息，让消费者能选择维修，同时保留安全限制。
明确法律要求的对象是厂家。

The main benefit is that repairable products can remain in use for longer. If a battery or cable can be replaced without damaging the whole device, a small failure does not necessarily require a complete new purchase. This can reduce waste and help consumers avoid unnecessary expense. At present, willingness to repair is not enough if parts are unavailable or a product cannot be opened without breaking it. Manufacturers control many of these decisions at the design stage, so they are in a stronger position than individual buyers to remove the barriers. Clear information about repair options would also help people compare products before buying them.
电池或线坏不应导致整机丢弃，厂家比消费者更能从设计阶段消除维修障碍。
解释控制权为什么带来责任。

However, requirements should be practical rather than assuming that every repair can be carried out at home. Certain components may require trained technicians or specific tools to handle safely. Manufacturers may also face additional costs when maintaining spare parts for older models. Rules should therefore define suitable periods and responsibilities for different product types, while allowing professional repair where needed. Independent repair services could benefit from access to appropriate parts and instructions, provided that relevant standards are followed. The goal is not to remove all technical complexity but to prevent avoidable obstacles that make otherwise useful products impossible to maintain.
有些维修需专业人员，旧型号备件也有成本，规则应按产品类型规定合理责任。
承认安全成本，提出规则设计边界。

In conclusion, manufacturers should take greater responsibility for repairability because their choices strongly affect a product's useful life. Well-designed requirements can support longer use without ignoring cost or safety. Consumers should be able to consider repair as a realistic option rather than being pushed towards replacement by unnecessary design restrictions.
目标是消除人为障碍，不是假定人人都能在家修所有东西。
结论回扣 realistic option。

practice.frame: Manufacturers should provide [support] so that consumers can [benefit].
practice.answer: Manufacturers should provide replacement batteries so that consumers can keep using an otherwise functional device.
practice.transfer: 选一件产品，写厂家能采取的一项设计或备件措施，以及消费者因此获得的选择。

During a trial, staff noted how often shoppers asked about repair options. Sales figures were collected separately and have not yet been compared with the questions. The shop intends to extend the cards to more products if manufacturers provide sufficient information.

speakingGuide.explain: 描述邻里互助的一种方式。通过一个小例子说明谁帮助谁、怎样帮、带来什么作用。
paragraphs: In my neighbourhood, people help one another by collecting parcels for neighbours who are away. I first noticed this when I moved into my building last year. There is a small residents' group where people can ask for help.
去年搬入楼里后发现邻居会在住户群里互相代收包裹。
先概括一种互助，不必罗列很多。

Last month, I was waiting for an important delivery but had to attend a class. A neighbour offered to receive it for me. I collected it that evening and thanked her. Later, I returned the favour when she needed someone to water her plants for a weekend.
上个月上课时邻居帮收重要快递，后来她外出我帮浇花。
一次帮助和一次回报形成完整故事。

These are small actions, but they make daily life easier. They also give people a reason to talk and build trust. I think a friendly community often begins with simple, practical help rather than large organised events.
小事让生活方便、建立信任，友好社区常从实际帮助开始。
从个人经历自然上升到社区意义。

writingGuide.explain: 讨论食品浪费应由企业负责还是由其他参与者承担，并给观点。示范认为企业在其可控环节有重要责任，家庭与公共政策也需参与。
outline: 引言：企业重要但不是唯一责任方
主体一：企业控制采购和销售
主体二：消费者与公共支持的责任
paragraphs: Businesses play a major role in how food is purchased, prepared, and sold, so some people believe they should be responsible for reducing waste. Others emphasise the choices of consumers and the role of public policy. In my view, businesses should take substantial responsibility for the stages they control, but lasting improvement requires action from other groups as well.
企业应对可控环节负主要责任，但消费者和公共政策同样必要。
给出明确个人意见：重要但共享责任。

The case for business responsibility is strong because companies can influence large quantities of food. A retailer decides how much to order, how products are displayed, and whether unsold items are discounted in time. Restaurants can review which dishes are frequently left unfinished and offer suitable portion sizes. These changes may prevent waste before it occurs, rather than relying only on disposal arrangements afterwards. Businesses also have information about sales patterns that individual customers cannot access. Using this information carefully can help them match supplies to demand and reduce unnecessary excess while continuing to offer customers a reasonable choice.
企业决定订货、陈列、折扣、份量，掌握销量信息，可源头减少剩余。
企业行为列举后解释如何减少损失。

Consumers, however, affect what happens after food is bought. A shop cannot fully control whether a household stores an item correctly or plans to use it. People therefore need to check supplies, buy appropriate amounts, and understand reliable storage information. Public authorities and community organisations can support both businesses and households through clear guidance and practical arrangements for handling suitable surplus food safely. Small businesses may need help understanding these systems rather than simply receiving criticism. Treating waste as the fault of only one group risks leaving important parts of the process unchanged.
售后家庭储存和购买量由消费者决定，公共机构可提供清晰说明和安全处理剩余的支持。
另一观点不是免除企业责任，而是补齐后续环节。

In conclusion, businesses should be accountable for reducing food waste within their operations because they control important decisions and resources. Yet they cannot solve the entire problem alone. A shared approach, with responsibilities linked to what each participant can influence, is more effective than assigning all blame to either companies or consumers.
按各方能影响的环节分担，而非把所有责任推给一方。
总结责任分配原则。

practice.frame: Businesses can reduce waste by [action], while households should [action].
practice.answer: Businesses can reduce waste by adjusting orders to demand, while households should check supplies before shopping.
practice.transfer: 以超市或餐厅为例，写它能控制的一件事和消费者应配合的一件事。

A fourth bakery has expressed interest, although no collection arrangement has been agreed.

speakingGuide.explain: 描述澄清误会的一次经历。讲清双方误解在哪里、你如何确认，避免只责备别人。
paragraphs: Last month, I arranged to meet a friend at a café before going to a film. I sent a short message saying we should meet at six. Unfortunately, there were two cafés with the same name, and we went to different branches.
约朋友六点在咖啡馆见，但同名两店，双方去了不同分店。

When I arrived and could not see him, I called instead of sending more short messages. We compared the addresses and realised what had happened. I sent a map location, and we agreed to meet at the branch closer to the cinema.
找不到后打电话对地址，发地图位置，改在影院附近分店会合。
给出解决沟通的具体动作。

We still reached the film on time. I apologised for not including the address, and we both laughed about the confusion. Since then, I have tried to confirm the place and time clearly whenever I make plans with someone.
没错过电影，也为没写地址道歉，从此明确时间地点。
讲自己的责任与改进，故事更自然。

practice.answer: We misunderstood which café to meet at, so I called my friend to confirm the address.
practice.transfer: 换成一次消息或任务误会，说清你如何核对而不是只说 I explained it。

writingGuide.explain: 这是困难与解决办法双问题，讨论转发前核查信息。写出普通用户为什么难做到，并给对应的低门槛方法，不要只谴责造谣。
outline: 引言：认可核查但有现实障碍
主体一：速度压力与缺乏背景
主体二：简单核查习惯与平台支持
结论：用户与平台共同降低门槛
paragraphs: Checking information before sharing it is a sensible expectation, but ordinary social media users face practical difficulties. Posts move quickly, sources may be unclear, and users often lack specialist knowledge. These barriers can be reduced through simple checking habits and platform features that make reliable context easier to find before a message spreads further.
核查合理，但快节奏、来源不清和知识不足构成障碍。
双问题分别安排主体，结构清楚。

One difficulty is the pressure to react immediately. A surprising or emotional post may encourage someone to share it before considering whether it is accurate. The original source may also be missing from a screenshot or short video, making it hard to understand when and where the material was produced. Even when a report is linked, a user may not have the knowledge to assess a technical claim. Searching online can produce more copies of the same unsupported statement rather than independent confirmation. As a result, a person may mistake repetition for evidence and become more confident without actually learning anything new.
情绪化消息催促转发，截图缺日期地点，搜索可能只找到重复传言，误把重复当证据。
描述普通人会遇到的具体困难。

A useful solution is to establish a short routine before sharing. Users can look for the original source, check the date, and ask whether the available evidence supports the headline. If the claim cannot be verified, choosing not to share it is a reasonable response. Platforms can support this by making source information visible and encouraging users to open linked material before forwarding it. Schools and community programmes can also demonstrate checking with everyday examples. The aim should be to develop a manageable process, not to expect everyone to become an expert in every subject they encounter.
先查原始来源、日期和标题证据，无法核实可不转；平台提供背景和阅读提示，教学用日常例子。
解决措施逐项对应速度、背景、知识。

In conclusion, speed, missing context, and limited knowledge make verification difficult. A combination of practical user habits and better platform support can reduce these problems. Creating a brief pause and making uncertainty acceptable may be more effective than simply telling people to be responsible without showing them how.
建立可做的小流程，比空泛要求负责更有帮助。
不要求用户掌握所有专业知识。

practice.frame: One difficulty is [barrier]. A practical response is to [checking action].
practice.answer: One difficulty is that screenshots often lack dates. A practical response is to find the original post before sharing.
practice.transfer: 用一张无日期截图作例子，写一个困难和两步可执行的核查动作。

lessons.focus: 练习 Y/N/NG 与 T/F/NG 的区别；不把作者观点当事实题。
lessons.text: A social media account shared a photograph of a closed railway station with a warning about travel disruption. A reader noticed that the original photograph had been taken during repairs two years earlier. The station operator confirmed that normal services were currently running. The account added a correction and a link to the operator's timetable. It did not remove the original post because it wanted readers to see the correction. There is no published information about how many people changed their travel plans after seeing the first message.

FALSE
与原文矛盾。证据：It did not remove the original post because it wanted readers to see the correction.
Hundreds of passengers changed their travel plans.

TRUE

speakingGuide.explain: 描述用数字帮助决策的一次经历。选预算、时间或价格，说明比较了什么和如何算。
paragraphs: I used numbers to decide whether to buy a monthly bus pass. This happened when I started visiting the library more often. I wrote down the price of one return trip and estimated how many trips I would make in a month.
去图书馆频率增加后考虑买公交月票，记下往返单价和预计次数。
交代要作出的决定，数字才有用途。

Then I multiplied the trip cost by the number of visits and compared the total with the pass price. I also considered that I might miss a few visits during a busy week. This helped me avoid assuming I would travel every day.
计算单价乘次数，与月票比较，也考虑忙时少去几次。
可讲计算过程，不一定报精确金额。

I decided to pay for individual journeys because my expected use was still quite low. The calculation was simple, but it stopped me from choosing a pass just because it sounded like a bargain. I learned to check the numbers against my actual habits.
最终次数少，选单次付费，避免只因听起来优惠而购买，要符合实际习惯。
解释选择如何来自比较结果。

practice.frame: I compared [cost A] with [cost B]. Because [reason], I chose [option].
practice.answer: I compared the cost of separate journeys with a monthly pass. Because I travelled less often, I chose separate tickets.
practice.transfer: 换成你的预算决定；若说具体数字，先检查计算一致。

writingGuide.explain: 是否应更重视统计理解？重点是读懂数据、比例与不确定性，不等于多教复杂计算。示范支持，并解释课程如何落实。
outline: 主体二：实际案例与基础结合
结论：理解数字而非只会计算
paragraphs: Numerical information appears in news, advertising, and many everyday decisions. I agree that schools should place more emphasis on understanding statistics. Students need to do more than perform calculations correctly; they also need to recognise what a set of numbers can show, what it leaves out, and which conclusions are justified by the evidence.
支持加强统计理解，学生不仅要算对，还要懂数字能说明什么和限制。
抓住 understanding，不把题目写成是否多学数学。

A stronger understanding of statistics can help students interpret claims more carefully. For example, a report may describe a large percentage increase without showing the original quantity. A change from a very small starting point can sound dramatic even when the absolute difference is limited. Students should learn to ask about the baseline, the source of the data, and the group being described. Similarly, a survey of a few volunteers may not represent an entire population. Recognising these limitations would help young people avoid accepting a conclusion simply because it contains figures or is presented in a professional-looking chart.
百分比增幅可能掩盖很小的基数，少量自愿者调查也不代表所有人，应查基数、来源、群体。
用基数和样本两个直观例子。

This emphasis can be introduced through practical examples rather than only more difficult formulas. Students could compare two charts showing the same information with different scales, or design a small class survey and discuss who was not included. Such activities should build on basic mathematical knowledge, not replace it. Teachers also need to connect the calculations with the questions being investigated. Finding an average is more meaningful when students consider whether it gives a useful picture of the data. This approach would make statistics relevant to other subjects and encourage careful reasoning about evidence.
比较不同刻度图表、设计班级调查等实操结合基础数学，计算要服务问题。
说明实际教学方法，使建议可理解。

In conclusion, schools should give greater attention to statistical understanding because it supports informed judgement in many situations. The aim should be to combine essential calculations with interpretation, context, and awareness of limitations. Students would then be better prepared to use numbers thoughtfully rather than being impressed or confused by them.
把计算、解读和局限一起教，帮助理性判断。
重申核心能力。

practice.frame: A statistic may be misleading if [missing context]. Students should ask [question].
practice.answer: A statistic may be misleading if the starting value is missing. Students should ask how large the original quantity was.
practice.transfer: 用“从 1 增至 2”说明百分比和实际增量的差别，再写查基数的重要性。

lessons.name: 比较数据
lessons.focus: 复习趋势词汇；同一单位内比较，避免混淆总量和比例。
lessons.text: A community college reported that the proportion of students using online materials rose from one year to the next. During the same period, total enrolment fell. A teacher pointed out that a higher proportion did not necessarily mean a higher number of users. To calculate the number, readers would need both the percentage and the total enrolment for each year. The published summary included percentages only. The college plans to include the missing totals in its next report. It has not asked students why they chose particular materials.
questions: Students preferred online materials because they were cheaper.
NOT GIVEN
原文没有提供这项结果或数量，不能凭常识推断。
The published summary omitted total enrolment figures.
TRUE
与原文一致。证据：The published summary included percentages only.
Total enrolment increased during the period.
FALSE
与原文矛盾。证据：During the same period, total enrolment fell.

speakingGuide.explain: 描述社区需要的一项设施。说明谁的什么需求没满足，以及设施应有哪些实际功能。
paragraphs: I think my community needs a shared study room. Many people live in small flats, and it can be difficult to find a quiet place to read. I noticed this myself when I tried to study while building work was taking place nearby.
社区小户型多，附近施工时难学习，因此需要共享自习室。
从自己遇到的需要切入。

The room would not need to be large. It could have desks, good lighting, and a few power sockets. Students and adults preparing for exams could book a place for a short session. Clear rules about noise would help everyone use it comfortably.
不用大，但要桌子、照明、插座，学生和备考成人可预约，明确安静规则。
功能选三项即可，别变设备清单。

This facility would give residents an affordable space to concentrate. I would use it in the evening after work or class. If there were enough interest, an unused room in the community centre might be a practical starting point.
提供负担得起的专注空间，可先利用社区中心空房。
补一个实际实施方式，让建议完整。

practice.frame: Our community needs [facility] so that [people] can [activity].
practice.answer: Our community needs a shared study room so that residents can read in a quiet place.
practice.transfer: 换成你社区缺少的设施，写出两个必要功能与一个受益群体。

writingGuide.explain: 讨论公共设施是否人人免费，双方都要写并给观点。示范基本服务免费，部分额外项目可合理收费，注意免费不等于没有运营成本。
outline: 引言：普遍可及但需经费
主体二：运营成本与适当收费
结论：基础免费、额外项目灵活
paragraphs: Public facilities serve the wider community, so some people argue that everyone should be able to use them free of charge. Others believe that users should contribute to their costs. I support free access to essential community resources, while allowing reasonable charges for certain optional services where these help maintain quality without excluding people in need.
支持基本公共资源免费，部分额外服务可合理收费且照顾困难群体。
明确区别不同服务，但仍回应人人免费争议。

Free access can remove a barrier for residents with limited incomes. A public library, park, or basic community space may provide opportunities to learn, exercise, and meet others that would otherwise be difficult to afford. Requiring a fee every time someone enters could discourage regular use, especially for families. These facilities also create benefits beyond the individual visitor. For example, a library that supports reading and study can contribute to a community's educational life. This provides a reason for sharing some costs through public funding rather than expecting each user to pay the full amount at the door.
收费会阻碍低收入家庭使用，图书馆、公园也带来社区教育和交往收益，适合共同承担成本。
说明免费如何带来个人与公共收益。

However, facilities need staff, cleaning, repairs, and equipment. If funding is insufficient, making every service free could lead to overcrowding or declining quality. Some activities also involve additional costs that are not created by ordinary access. A specialist class or a private booking of a sports space may reasonably carry a charge. The important issue is how fees are designed. Reduced prices, exemptions, and free sessions can protect access for people who would otherwise be excluded. Decisions should reflect the purpose and actual costs of the service, rather than treating all facilities and activities as identical.
维护和人手需经费，特殊课程或专用场地可收费，通过减免和免费时段防止排除。
讨论真实成本并提出公平安排。

In conclusion, basic public access should generally be protected because these facilities support the whole community. Nevertheless, carefully designed charges for some optional services may help keep them sustainable. A fair system combines dependable public funding with appropriate support for users who cannot afford extra costs.
基础可及与持续运营应结合。
有具体立场，不只是两边都好。

practice.frame: Free access helps [group] to [benefit], but charges for [optional service] may cover [cost].
practice.answer: Free access helps families use the library, but charges for an optional workshop may cover specialist materials.
practice.transfer: 选一种公共设施，分别写应免费的基本部分和可能合理收费的额外部分。

A proposal suggested lower morning fees to attract new groups. Existing evening bookings would not be cancelled. Before introducing the change, the council asked potential users about suitable times and transport. Several groups said cheaper fees alone would not solve their difficulties. The council has not estimated the additional income the proposal might generate. A decision is expected after the consultation ends.

speakingGuide.explain: 描述随时间变化的一个地方。用过去、现在对比，既能说改善也能说失去的东西。
paragraphs: A place that has changed is a small shopping street near my old school. When I was a child, it had several family shops and a narrow pavement. I used to buy snacks there after class with my friends.
以前学校旁的小商业街有人家小店、人行道窄，放学常买零食。
用童年或过去一次来访建立时间点。

I visited again recently and found wider pavements, new trees, and a small café where an old grocery shop had been. Some familiar shops were still there, but the street looked brighter and felt easier to walk along. There were also more places to sit.
重访发现人行道更宽、有树和新咖啡馆，也保留部分老店，座椅更多。
选择可见变化进行对照。

I liked the improvements because the area was more comfortable for pedestrians. At the same time, I missed a few shops I remembered. I hope future changes will make the street convenient while allowing it to keep some of its original character.
步行舒服了，也怀念老店，希望便利与原有特色兼顾。

writingGuide.explain: 题目问学校应否让学生参加本地环保项目。示范赞同有教育目的、安全且与课堂相连的项目，不能只讨论环保总体重要性。
outline: 引言：支持有教学设计的参与
主体一：把知识连到实际
主体二：安全、可及与时间安排
paragraphs: Schools can teach environmental topics through classroom lessons, but local projects offer a different way to understand them. I agree that students should be involved in such activities, provided that the projects have clear learning goals and are organised safely. Participation should strengthen education rather than simply provide unpaid labour or an opportunity for publicity.
支持本地环保活动，但需明确学习目标和安全安排，不只是劳动或宣传。
直接赞同并限定有教学意义的参与。

A local project can connect an abstract idea with something students can observe. For example, a class studying waste could examine how materials are sorted at school, identify a problem, and test clearer signs near the bins. Students would then have a reason to collect information, compare results, and explain what changed. Working with others can also develop practical communication and planning skills. The value lies not only in completing the activity but in understanding why a particular action was chosen and whether it achieved its purpose. This makes the project part of a learning process rather than an isolated event.
学校垃圾分类项目能让学生观察、找问题、试标识、比结果，练沟通规划，理解为何有效。
用完整的小调查过程说明学习收益。

However, schools must consider safety, access, and the demands of the curriculum. Activities should be suitable for students' ages and abilities, with appropriate supervision. Not every student can take part in the same physical task, so useful roles might include recording information, preparing explanations, or presenting findings. Teachers also need time to connect the project with lessons before and afterwards. A brief, well-planned investigation may be more educational than a large event with no preparation or reflection. Local organisations can provide expertise, but the school should remain responsible for ensuring that the experience serves students' needs.
年龄能力、安全、课程时间都需考虑，可分记录和展示等不同角色，活动前后应有教学。
实际限制配对应解决办法。

In conclusion, local environmental projects can be a valuable part of school education when they combine action with explanation and reflection. I support their use as a complement to classroom learning. Clear goals, inclusive roles, and careful organisation are necessary to make participation both meaningful and manageable.
项目是课堂补充，重点在行动结合解释反思。
收束为行动加反思，而非只做一次活动。

practice.frame: A local project can help students understand [topic] by [specific activity].
practice.answer: A local project can help students understand waste sorting by testing clearer signs near school bins.
practice.transfer: 设计一个安全的小调查：看什么、改变什么、怎样判断有没有改善。

lessons.name: 保护与监测
lessons.focus: 四科整合：限时定位、两分钟表达、检查证据。
lessons.text: A school restored a neglected pond with help from local volunteers. Students planted native vegetation around the edge and recorded visible animals once a month. More types of insects were observed during the summer than during the first winter survey. Their teacher explained that seasonal differences made a direct comparison difficult. The class will repeat the winter survey before discussing longer-term changes. Students have not tested the water for chemical pollutants. They keep photographs alongside their notes so that future classes can see how the pond developed.
questions: Students have already tested the water for chemical pollutants.
FALSE
与原文矛盾。证据：Students have not tested the water for chemical pollutants.
Restoration doubled the total number of animals.
NOT GIVEN
原文没有提供这项结果或数量，不能凭常识推断。
The class plans to repeat the winter survey.
TRUE
与原文一致。证据：The class will repeat the winter survey before discussing longer-term changes.

speakingGuide.explain: 描述通过练习改善的能力。以一个可观察的进步结束这30天，也可以讲英语之外的技能。
paragraphs: Something I have improved through practice is introducing myself in English. A few weeks ago, I could understand simple introductions, but I felt nervous when I had to speak. I often stopped after saying my name because I was trying to make every sentence perfect.
几周前理解简单自我介绍，但轮到自己常说完名字就停，过度追求完美。
起点要具体到一个困难。

I began by writing three simple points about my studies, interests, and future plans. Then I recorded myself and listened for places where I paused. I practised the same ideas again using slightly different words instead of memorising one fixed paragraph.
先写学习、兴趣、计划三点，录音找停顿，用不同表达重练而不是背固定段落。
说明怎样利用回听反馈改进。

Now I can give a short introduction with fewer pauses. I still need to improve my pronunciation and develop longer answers, but I am more willing to begin. The main lesson for me is that small, repeated attempts can make speaking feel less frightening.
现在短介绍停顿少，仍需练发音和长回答，但更愿开口，重复尝试减轻紧张。
既肯定进步，也提出下一步目标。

writingGuide.explain: 讨论以个人进步还是与他人比较来判断进展。示范日常学习重自身变化，选拔或资格判断仍需共同标准；不要把竞争一概否定。
outline: 引言：两种比较用途不同
主体一：自身进步提供具体反馈
主体二：共同标准帮助判断水平
paragraphs: Progress can be judged by comparing someone's current performance with their earlier work or by comparing them with other people. Both approaches provide information, but they answer different questions. I believe personal improvement should be central to everyday learning, while shared standards remain useful when a decision requires a clear measure of current ability.
日常学习应重个人进步，共同标准适合判断当前是否能完成特定任务。
区分问题用途，给讨论双方的框架。

Looking at personal improvement can make feedback more meaningful. Two learners may begin with very different levels of experience, so their positions in a ranking do not show how much either has developed. A student who moves from writing disconnected sentences to producing a clear paragraph has made progress even if classmates still write more fluently. Recognising that change can help the student identify what worked and what to practise next. It also encourages attention to specific skills rather than a general feeling of being better or worse than others. This is especially useful for beginners who might otherwise feel discouraged by constant comparison.
起点不同，名次不反映发展；从散句到清楚段落也是进步，有助发现有效方法和下一步。
用初学写作例子支持个人比较。

However, comparison with a wider standard has legitimate uses. An employer or university may need to know whether a person can perform certain tasks now, not only whether they have improved. External examples can also reveal weaknesses that a learner has not noticed. The difficulty is that competition becomes unhelpful when rankings are treated as a complete description of someone's ability or worth. A common assessment standard, supported by specific feedback, is more informative than simply announcing who came first. Learners need to understand both their current level and the practical steps that could help them develop further.
学校或雇主需知道现有能力，外部样例可暴露盲点，但不能用排名代表全部价值，应给具体反馈。
承认共同标准的现实功能并说明限制。

In conclusion, personal improvement is a valuable guide for daily practice because it recognises different starting points and directs future effort. Comparison can still help establish readiness for a particular task. Using each measure for a clear purpose is more useful than allowing rankings alone to define progress.
自身变化指导日常练习，外部标准判断准备程度，按目的使用。
综合但不是模糊折中。

lessons.text: An evening art class asked learners to select two pieces for a small exhibition. One piece had to come from the beginning of the course and the other from a later session. Learners wrote short notes describing what they had tried to improve. Visitors could leave comments, but there were no prizes or rankings. Some learners selected unfinished work because it showed an important experiment. The teacher photographed the display with permission. No formal assessment scores were published, and the class has not decided whether to repeat the exhibition next year.
